notes.title: New Trailer Update for RrrrrAbbits!
notes.notes:
Hello!
I'm Nanahara, the developer behind RrrrrAbbits.

Today, we are excited to announce that RrrrrAbbits is being showcased at INDIE Live Expo 2025!
To celebrate, we've updated our trailer! 🎥
This first official PV showcases the experience of protecting your rabbit herd, exploring, and building your village. It’s now available on our store page, so please check it out and look forward to future updates and progress!

Thank you for your continued support!
We’d love to hear your thoughts and feedback! 🐇✨

notes.title: "Want to Be in a Game?" Contest Now Open!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! This is Nanahara, the developer of RrrrrAbbits.
We're excited to announce that the "Want to Be in a Game?" contest is now open!

🎮 Event Overview
We're looking to add an Akihabara-like, lively atmosphere to certain areas within the game. To do this, we're inviting VTubers, streamers, and creators to submit their posters and advertisements to be featured in the game!✨

🐰 The World of RrrrrAbbits Evolves! 🎮
The designs of the selected submissions will appear as posters, billboards, displays, and NPC clothing in the city’s urban areas.
A part of the city will transform into an Akihabara-inspired zone, allowing players to discover the unique designs of VTubers and streamers in-game!

As players explore, they will enjoy discovering designs that make them stop and say "Wow!" as they walk through the streets.

We look forward to seeing how RrrrrAbbits will continue to evolve with your contributions! Thank you for your support!
